exercises.question: Choose the grammar pattern that matches: "Verb てしまう".

options.text: A とか B とか
A は B ほど～ありません
A は B ほど～ない

exercises.correctFeedback: Great! 動詞てしまう matches "Verb てしまう".
exercises.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. The correct pattern is 動詞てしまう.
exercises.explanation: Expresses completion or regret; attach しまう to the verb’s て-form.
